crossRefs.note: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea; Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians; Gaius of Derbe…
Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

people.name: Ephesus
people.line: Major city in Asia Minor; important center for early Christianity

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

people.name: Trophimus
people.line: Gentile Christian from Ephesus, companion of Paul

translations.web: For they had seen Trophimus, the Ephesian, with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
translations.bsb: For they had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they assumed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
translations.kjv: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
translations.asv: For they had before seen with him in the city Trophimus the Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.
